name: terrabeegle
description: Web app made for the Terranova Challenge proposed in 42 Florence

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npx --yes concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d 2>/dev/null || (systemctl is-active --quiet postgresql 2>/dev/null || sudo systemctl start postgresql 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend-TerraBeegle install && dotnet restore Backend-TerraBeegle
